name: Network Service Engineering
description: Diagnose an arbitrary TCP or UDP service from listeners, DNS, routes, and the protocol you observed.

permissionsRequired.reason: Run a command the project files or the host evidence justify.
See which process is listening or failing.
Read the file the change or diagnosis depends on.
Run a command on a configured server alias.
Read logs for a process this run already started.

validation.rule: Listeners, bind address, ports, and the path that failed were cited. The fault was not assumed to be the firewall.
